description: This is the main application source file for a React-based frontend of a zoo monitoring dashboard. It defines routing, navigation control, authentication gating, and incorporates various page components relevant to zoo monitoring functionalities.

classes.name: Shell
classes.description: Main component managing app-level navigation, route-based UI logic, and conditional component rendering based on authentication and species selection status.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Root component wrapping the application with React Router's BrowserRouter, initializing the routing context.

methods.name: Shell()
methods.description: React functional component that manages route-based navigation and UI display logic, including authentication gating, species selection gating, and conditional rendering of navigation bar and chatbot.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: React functional component that initializes the application's routing context and renders the Shell component.
